errors.text_span: wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen jedes Jahr stehen
errors.evidence: The tick labels on the x-axis are for every two years (1995, 1997, 1999, etc.), not every year.

errors.text_span: Eine schwarze durchgehende Linie stellt die Eurozone dar
errors.evidence: The legend indicates that the Eurozone is represented by a black dashed line (schwarze gestrichelte Linie), not a solid one.
The line for the Eurozone (black dashed) starts at approximately 75% in 1995, not 65%.
The line for the Eurozone ends at approximately 90% in 2025, not 110%.

errors.text_span: Eine schwarze gestrichelte Linie repräsentiert Belgien
errors.evidence: The legend shows that Belgium is represented by a black dotted line (schwarze gepunktete Linie), while the black dashed line represents the Eurozone.
The line for Belgium (black dotted) starts at approximately 130% in 1995, not 110%.
The line for Germany (dark blue) starts at approximately 55-60% in 1995, not 115%.
The line for Germany is rising around 2005, reaching about 68%. It does not fall to 55%.

errors.text_span: steigt dann auf 75 % im Jahr 2025 an
errors.evidence: The line for Germany ends at approximately 65% in 2025, not 75%.

errors.text_span: Eine violette Linie stellt Griechenland dar
errors.evidence: The violet line represents Spain (Spanien), while the light blue line represents Greece (Griechenland).

errors.text_span: beginnt bei 110 % im Jahr 1995, sinkt auf 60 % im Jahr 2000, steigt dann auf 150 % im Jahr 2012 und 180 % im Jahr 2023 an
errors.evidence: This entire description is incorrect for the violet line (Spain), which starts at ~60%, stays low until ~2008, rises to ~85% in 2012 and ~110% in 2023. The values provided seem to be a mix of incorrect values and values from other lines (e.g., Greece).
The light green solid line represents Ireland (Irland), not Spain (Spanien).

errors.text_span: beginnt bei 110 % im Jahr 1995, fällt auf 60 % im Jahr 2000
errors.evidence: The light green line (Ireland) starts at ~80% in 1995 and falls to ~40% in 2000. The stated values are incorrect.
The light green line (Ireland) falls to approximately 40% in 2023, it does not reach 115%.
The line for France starts at approximately 55-60% in 1995, not 115%.
The line for France shows a continuous increase; it is at approximately 65% in 2007 and is not falling.
There is no light grey (hellgraue) line in the chart. Ireland is represented by a solid light green line.

errors.text_span: beginnt bei 100 % im Jahr 1995, fällt auf 60 % im Jahr 2000 und bleibt bis 2025 relativ stabil bei 70 %.
errors.evidence: This description does not match any line in the chart. Ireland's line (solid light green) starts at ~80%, falls to ~25%, spikes to ~120%, and then falls back to ~40%. The stated values and trend are completely wrong.
The description omits any mention of Italy (Italien), which is represented by the light green dashed line.
